Servitors breach the galleries. Mass casualties.

chronicle.event: Shake Rao arrives at Penn Station aboard Amtrak from Delaware. The Transport occurs.
Night Black Eyes art activates spontaneously. Shake gains darkvision. Removes contacts — vision is clearer without them.
Shake opens train emergency door release and leads 12 passengers out of darkened Amtrak car into Penn Station tunnel.

Shake retrieves duffel bag of food from train. Attempts first accursed blade manifestation — Effort committed, blade appears but unstable (Magic/INT check failed, 6 vs DC 8). Blade causes pain on manifestation, flickers.

Group moves toward platform. Notice/scavenge FAILED (3 vs DC 6) — nothing useful found. Connect/leadership FAILED (4 vs DC 8) — group fragments, 5 passengers split off. Notice/threats FAILED (6 vs DC 8) — Shake misses the tracery pattern converging on the concourse until too late. Arrives at main concourse with 7 of 12 passengers.

Shake loots Penn Station shop for water and energy bars (Notice SUCCESS, 7 vs DC 6), leaves cash. Fails to identify safer exit (Know FAILED, 7 vs DC 8) — heads directly toward 7th Ave central stairwell where tracery shimmer is thickest. Approaching breach point with 7 civilians.

Shake spots servitors (3 stone-insect constructs) behind thinning shimmer at 7th Ave stairwell. Quietly retreats group (DEX SUCCESS, 8 vs DC 8). Rallies concourse crowd toward 8th Ave exits (Connect SUCCESS, 11 vs DC 9, margin +2). Significant portion of crowd redirected. Shimmer still thinning — breach imminent.

Shake emerges from 8th Ave exit with ~47 survivors. FIRST REVELATION: world_outside — Manhattan is inside a colossal cavern. No sky. Bioluminescent blue-green ceiling ~200ft up. Underground lake surrounds the island. Gallery mouths visible in distant cavern walls. Behind them, gallery seal breach begins (clock_gallery_seals → 1, portent fired). Screaming from below.

Shake treks 2 miles east from 8th Ave to apartment near Bellevue through panicking Manhattan streets. Scavenges supplies from abandoned bodega (Notice SUCCESS, 8 vs DC 7, margin +1): water bottles x3, canned tuna x2, box of crackers. Penn Station group dispersed during trek — each heading to their own people. Witnesses chaos: subway entrances with screaming from below, thousands on streets, no working technology, blue-green cavern light. Arrives at apartment building.

clock_log.reason: Servitor shimmer collapse at Penn Station 7th Ave stairwell. Breach begins across Manhattan subway galleries.

world_pulse.news: Sunday evening, normal commuter traffic. Amtrak Northeast Regional arriving Penn Station.
